name: live-fetch verification

VML.note: Every ID independently confirmed with title match; several corroborated by venue (ICLR/ASPLOS 2026) or GitHub repo. Name-vs-title nuances: Critical Sharpness = metric inside a curvature paper; ProGRPO = method inside 'Back to Basics...'; AutoTTS = Auto Test-Time Scaling (not TTS speech).

suspect_concepts.name: Fish-sauce salt-layer
suspect_concepts.corrected: salt is the PRIMARY (not sole) control parameter gating enzyme-vs-microbe regimes

suspect_concepts.name: Constrictor knot
suspect_concepts.issue: 'capstan effect' attribution overstated; jamming is crossing-turn geometry compressing the bound object
suspect_concepts.corrected: self-jamming from crossing-turn geometry; friction rises with load (not a strict capstan equation)

suspect_concepts.name: Arabic Geomancy
suspect_concepts.issue: 'adjacent XOR-parity' loosely conflates transpose (Daughters) with pairwise addition (Nieces); 11 figures correct excluding optional Reconciler
suspect_concepts.corrected: Daughters by transpose; Nieces/Witnesses/Judge by pairwise XOR-parity addition; Judge even-parity = checksum

suspect_concepts.name: Aboriginal Songlines
suspect_concepts.issue: HOOK PARTIALLY DEBUNKED: 'recoverable from any one substrate' is an embellishment; sources say complementary/mutually-reinforcing, NOT individually sufficient
suspect_concepts.corrected: 4 complementary redundant substrates (melody/dance/narrative/landscape); cross-reinforcing, not guaranteed full single-channel recovery

suspect_concepts.name: Change-ringing Plain Bob
suspect_concepts.issue: HOOK PARTIALLY DEBUNKED: 'Hamiltonian circuit through all n! permutations' true only for small n (Minimus); n>4 needs bobs/compositions for a full extent
suspect_concepts.corrected: minimal adjacent-swap permutation sequence; a FULL extent of all n! requires composed bobs/singles, not automatic

suspect_concepts.name: Ebru marbling
suspect_concepts.issue: conflates ox-gall (pigment spreading agent) vs alum (paper mordant)
suspect_concepts.corrected: ox-gall lets pigment float/spread on the size; alum-mordanted paper fixes pigment on contact; single-lift transfer is real

key_finding: 0 fabrications, but 6/24 life concepts had EMBELLISHED mechanisms — and 2 (Songlines 'any-one-channel recovery', Plain-Bob 'all n!') had their most computationally-attractive feature overstated. This is the pretrained-fallback tendency the architecture guards against, caught at Stage 1. Merge agents must use the CORRECTED mechanisms; the 2 hook-debunked concepts are flagged 'with_caution' so no merge is built on a false premise.
verdict: PASS — 0 fabrications; all 36 concepts are real. Proceed to merge with corrected mechanisms.
